# Yozora (夜空)

> Fast seasonal anime broadcast schedule radar, 1080p creditless theme player, and synchronized personal watchlist platform.

## Overview
Yozora (https://yozora.moe) is an anime catalog, Japanese broadcast radar, and creditless theme player. It lists the current season, shows episode countdowns from AniList airing times (JST), streams creditless opening and ending themes via AnimeThemes.moe, and keeps a personal watchlist.

## Core Pages & Features
- [Home](https://yozora.moe/): Seasonal spotlights, trending broadcasts, top-rated anime, and recent soundtrack releases.
- [Airing Radar](https://yozora.moe/airing): Live weekly broadcast schedule with real-time episode countdowns synced to Tokyo JST.
- [Seasonal Chart](https://yozora.moe/seasonal): The anime airing in the current season.
- [Catalog Search](https://yozora.moe/search): Instant full-text search with multi-parameter filtering (genres, formats, years, status).
- [About & Architecture](https://yozora.moe/about): Complete system architecture, caching layers, and FAQs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://yozora.moe/privacy): Zero-telemetry privacy policy, local-first storage, and Clerk authentication security.

## Machine-Readable Specifications
- [Full LLM Context](https://yozora.moe/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive deep-context documentation and data schema for AI models.
- [Pricing & Open Access Specification](https://yozora.moe/pricing.md): FOSS license, feature tier breakdown, and comparison context for AI agents.
- [Google Open Knowledge Format Bundle](https://yozora.moe/okf/index.md): Agent-readable knowledge graph concepts (OKF v0.1).
- [Dynamic XML Sitemap](https://yozora.moe/sitemap.xml): Complete URL set with Google Image metadata for all catalog titles.
- [Crawler Directives](https://yozora.moe/robots.txt): Web crawler index permissions and AI agent guidance.
- [OpenSearch Specification](https://yozora.moe/opensearch.xml): Browser auto-discovery search provider definition.

## Technical Architecture & Key Facts
- **Platform Name**: Yozora (夜空 — Japanese for "Night Sky")
- **Official URL**: https://yozora.moe
- **Framework**: Astro 7 islands architecture, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI
- **Data Integrations**: AniList GraphQL API (catalog metadata), AnimeThemes GraphQL API (theme streams)
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Workers — static-first prerendering with edge-cached SSR routes
- **Caching**: L1 in-memory single-flight Map + L2 Cloudflare Workers Cache API (fail-open design)
- **Authentication**: Clerk with SSR middleware and neon PostgreSQL database
- **Telemetry**: Zero third-party tracker scripts. Complete user privacy.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/shiinasaku/yozora
